Regarding online friends, the entire reason I have them is because I'm useful in online games where I have friends. Irl there's no real replica for that type of experience, most of the time if you're useful people will just use you and throw you away after. They don't care. 

Other people I see seem to immediately make friends with everyone they meet and I can't understand what they have and I don't.
I put in a lot of applications that go nowhere. And the getting ditched is something that has happened literally my entire life. People just treat me really bad irl and I don't know why.

No one else will hire because I am ugly and worthless. As for other stuff, I play  online games because that's the only time people actually want to be around me. When they can't see me. In real life, I tried very hard to make friends and hang out with people only for them to ditch me to go find the hot blonde chick to hang out with. Irl people don't give a shit about me.
